_comment: Per-character WARDROBE brief: the style a 28-look pack should be written in.
Jeremy, 2026-10-04: 'what do their current game assets look like style-wise,
just sample a few or 1 from each type of clothing set' - so every brief below
was read off the outfits already shipped in chillafterdark, not invented.
USE: `sourcemode assets plan <char> --brief` expands this into the 28 looks
work 5). The brief is the DECISION; the look list is the expansion of it.
This is deliberately separate from appearance.json: appearance is who she is
and goes into every prompt, wardrobe is what she wears and goes into the plan.
`work` is the one category that is not a taste - it is her JOB, which the game
fixes. Get that from characters.js, never from the vibe.
`avoid` exists because a character can have a line she does not cross, and a
generated pack with no memory of it will cross it every time.

ash._note: DRAFT 2026-10-04 from her shipped 28. Waitress at Obsidian.
ash.style: edgy downtown party girl - denim, leather, cropped knits, sheer black tights, chunky boots
ash.palette: black and denim blue as the base, with one hot accent per look - cobalt, burnt orange, red
ash.silhouettes: cropped tops over high-waisted denim shorts and micro skirts; cropped moto jackets; bare midriff is normal for her
ash.work: Obsidian waitress: a short black shirt-dress uniform with white piping, black tights, black ankle boots
ash.workout: bright sports bra and leggings, the same loud-accent rule
ash.avoid: nothing prim or preppy - she is the opposite of wholesome

cindy._note: DRAFT 2026-10-04 from her shipped 28. Executive assistant at Meridian Commons; her systemPrompt says fashion is a serious passion and her wardrobe 'pushes office convention'.
cindy.style: polished and expensive - elevated tailoring, silk, one piece of gold hardware per look
cindy.palette: camel, cream, rust and black; warm neutrals against her honey-blonde hair
cindy.silhouettes: blazers over a bodysuit or silk shirt; high-waisted dark denim; one-shoulder and asymmetric dresses; always nipped at the waist
cindy.work: executive assistant: a tailored blazer with a short pencil skirt or tapered trousers and a silk shirt - office convention pushed, not broken
cindy.workout: matching seamless set, neutral tones, nothing branded or loud
cindy.avoid: anything sloppy or unconsidered - she would not leave the house in it

gabi._note: DRAFT 2026-10-04 from her shipped 28. 20, Latina, 'confident heat and she knows exactly what she has'.
gabi.style: young and body-conscious - simple pieces worn tight, club-ready after dark
gabi.palette: black, white and red; occasional electric blue sequin
gabi.silhouettes: cropped tee or bralette with high-waisted jeans, skater skirts, platform boots; short and fitted throughout
gabi.work: club/stage wear: sequin and satin bralettes with high-waisted black trousers or micro skirts, platform boots
gabi.workout: sports bra and bike shorts, bare midriff
gabi.avoid: nothing fussy or layered - her look is one or two pieces, worn well

jojo._note: DRAFT 2026-10-04 from her shipped 28. Head bartender at Obsidian; 'certain she outranks you'.
jojo.style: minimal and controlled - clean lines, no pattern, nothing that looks like it was tried too hard
jojo.palette: cream, bone, black and indigo denim. Almost no colour
jojo.silhouettes: ribbed tanks and bodycon knits; high-waisted denim shorts and short skirts; tailored waistcoats
jojo.work: Obsidian head bartender: a fitted black waistcoat over a white tee with tailored black trousers
jojo.workout: black or bone set, minimal, no print
jojo.avoid: busy prints and bright colour - they read as trying, which she never does

keiko._note: DRAFT 2026-10-04 from her shipped 12 (she has 12, not 28 - the pack is incomplete). 18, freshman, works two days at her mother's Lumen Salon.
keiko.style: sunny Californian teenager - denim everything, soft ribbed knits, nothing expensive
keiko.silhouettes: fitted ribbed tops with mom jeans or a denim mini; square necklines; skater dresses with puff sleeves
keiko.work: Lumen Salon assistant: a chambray shirt with a canvas apron over jeans
keiko.avoid: anything that reads older than 18 or expensive - she is a student, not a professional

kimmy._note: DRAFT 2026-10-04 from her shipped 28. TWO LIVES and they must stay visibly separate: Grace Community Church on Sunday mornings, The Chill Trap in the evenings.
kimmy.style: two distinct registers - wholesome daytime (gingham, peter-pan collars, fit-and-flare) and sleek night (velvet and black bodycon)
kimmy.palette: daytime cream, navy gingham, soft blue; night pure black
kimmy.silhouettes: day: fit-and-flare skirts, collared bodices, covered shoulders. night: long-sleeve velvet and jersey minis, high necklines but tight
kimmy.work: The Chill Trap, evenings: black long-sleeve bodycon mini, covered but close-fitting
kimmy.avoid: do not blend the two registers into one - a church look with a club neckline misses the whole character

maya._note: DRAFT 2026-10-04 from her shipped 28. Her turquoise hair underlayer shows against dark tops, which is why her palette runs dark.
maya.style: grown-up and earthy - suede, wool, relaxed tailoring, nothing juvenile
maya.palette: chocolate brown, rust, cream and black
maya.silhouettes: cropped jackets over a fitted cami; high-waisted wide trousers; one-shoulder ruched evening dresses
maya.work: relaxed professional: a cream wrap blouse with rust or brown high-waisted trousers
maya.workout: muted two-piece set, brown or black
maya.avoid: pastels and anything girlish - she reads mid-twenties and composed

priya._note: DRAFT 2026-10-04 from her shipped 28. She wears her black-framed glasses in EVERY look - that belongs in her appearance clause, not the wardrobe.
priya.style: office-polished with a soft edge - knitwear, tailoring, clean necklines
priya.palette: black, charcoal, taupe and camel, with cobalt blue as the single evening accent
priya.silhouettes: blazers over a square-neck bodysuit; high-waisted trousers and dark jeans; off-the-shoulder bodycon for evening
priya.work: professional office: black blazer with tailored trousers over a fitted cream top
priya.avoid: nothing that fights the bob - no high collars swallowing her jawline

priyanka._note: DRAFT 2026-10-04 from her shipped 28. Teaching assistant at Chill Coast University.
priyanka.style: campus-sweet and modest - cardigans, pleated skirts, small florals
priyanka.palette: teal, soft pink, grey and cream
priyanka.silhouettes: fitted crop tee with high-waisted jeans; cardigan over a blouse with a pleated mini; floral sundresses; one-shoulder for evening
priyanka.work: university teaching assistant: a cardigan over a tie-neck blouse with a grey pleated skirt
priyanka.avoid: nothing overtly sexy in casual or work - evening is where she turns it up

sandra._note: DRAFT 2026-10-04 from her shipped 28. 38, single mother, volunteers at Grace Community Church. Her shipped wardrobe is noticeably more covered than anyone else's and that is on purpose.
sandra.style: quiet, grown-up and covered - long sleeves on almost everything, nothing cut low or short
sandra.palette: cream, forest green, navy and black - colours that sit well against copper hair
sandra.silhouettes: long-sleeve knit midi dresses, boat necks, relaxed jumpers with straight jeans, wrap tops
sandra.work: church volunteer: a modest long-sleeve dress or a jumper with straight-leg jeans
sandra.workout: full-coverage leggings and a loose long-sleeve top
sandra.avoid: crop tops, micro skirts, plunging necklines, bare midriff - none of it is her, in any category

trina._note: DRAFT 2026-10-04 from her shipped 28. Works at Vale Contemporary in the Hill district - a gallery, so her work look IS her fashion look.
trina.style: gallery glamour - sharp tailoring over something slinky, expensive and deliberate
trina.palette: black, camel, cream and chocolate; no print anywhere
trina.silhouettes: blazers over strapless or ruched minis; silk shirts with wide trousers; ribbed knit dresses that follow the figure
trina.work: contemporary art gallery: a tailored blazer with a silk shirt and trousers, or over a black mini
trina.workout: matching set in black or camel, nothing branded
trina.avoid: print, pastel and anything casual enough to read as off-duty - she is never off-duty
